# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a browser-native one-thumb liquid sort sandbox titled `Liquid Sort: No Thoughts Tri-Flask`. Preserve the mechanics of a falling-particle canvas board: tap/drag paints selected materials, brush sizes affect radius, sand falls, liquids fall and spread, stone blocks, plant is static/burnable, fire rises/decays/spreads/extinguishes in water, acid corrodes non-stone/non-acid matter, and particle count updates as the live progress signal. There is no win/loss target.

Visually, build a public-facing pastel rainbowcore fantasy shrine with a procedural Tri-Flask focal identity, rupee-diamond motifs, y2k glass HUD panels, fantasy-meme copy, and portrait-first mobile readability. Use clear CTAs and preserve native button tap behavior. Frame the loop as a satirical Zelda-adjacent liquid sort puzzle/toy: real, no thoughts head empty, commute-safe sorting.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved source is a single-file browser canvas falling-particle sandbox. The objective is open-ended play: choose a material, paint it onto the canvas with pointer/touch input, watch cellular rules move or transform it, pause/resume, and clear the board. There is no explicit win/loss condition or score target; the live particle count is the progress/score-like signal.

## Protected mechanics
- Canvas pointerdown/pointermove painting while active.
- Brush sizes 1, 3, and 5.
- Materials: empty/reset, sand, water, stone, plant, fire, acid.
- Bottom row initialized as stone.
- Sand falls and can displace water/fire.
- Water/acid fall and spread sideways; acid can dissolve non-stone, non-acid matter.
- Fire decays, rises, spreads to plant, and is extinguished by water.
- Pause/resume and clear/restart semantics.

## Remixed target
`Liquid Sort: No Thoughts Tri-Flask` reframes the same liquid/material flow as a satirical fantasy-adventure shrine sort game. The player paints rainbow shrine substances into a pastel Tri-Flask board using one thumb. Zelda-like cues are expressed through procedural flask, rune slab, rupee, fairy dew, moss, flame, and malice language without adding new rules.

## Safe presentation surfaces
Title, HUD copy, palette labels, colors, background motifs, procedural character/emblem styling, CTA language, audio accents, and feedback text are transformable. Core grid behavior and state flow are protected.
